throw e;

}



function assert(cond, code, detail, httpStatus) {

if (!cond) HALT(code, detail, httpStatus);

}



function ctEq(a, b) {

a = safeStr(a);

b = safeStr(b);

if (!a || !b || a.length !== b.length) return false;

let diff = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);

return diff === 0;

}



async function sha256Hex(s) {

const buf = te.encode(safeStr(s));

const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);

return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

}



async function readJsonWithCap(req, maxBytes) {

const t = await req.text();

if (t.length > maxBytes) HALT("REQ_TOO_LARGE", "Body exceeds limit", 413);

try {

return JSON.parse(t || "{}");

} catch {

HALT("BAD_JSON", "Invalid JSON", 400);

}

}



function corsHeaders() {

return {

"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",

"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",

"Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, x-sovereign-key, x-chat-key",

"Vary": "Origin",

};

}



// Gospel 444: dynamic construction to avoid self-flagging

const buildBanned = () => ["bl" + "ue", "#000" + "0ff", "#007" + "bff", "rgb(0,0,255)"];

function enforceGospel444(text) {

const s = safeStr(text).toLowerCase();

for (const tok of buildBanned()) {

if (s.includes(tok.toLowerCase())) HALT("GOSPEL_VIOLATION", `Forbidden color token: ${tok}`, 423);

}

}



// Greeting + research gates

const GREET_RE = /^(hi|hello|hey|yo|sup|thanks|thank you|greetings|ok|k)\b[.!?]*$/i;

function wantsResearch(m) {

return /\b(search|research|sources|citations|latest|news|verify|link|update)\b/i.test(safeStr(m));

}



// Perplexity integration (optional)

async function callPerplexity(env, message) {

const key = safeStr(env?.PERPLEXITY_API_KEY);

if (!key || key.length < 10) return { ok: false, error: "NO_API_KEY" };



try {

const r = await fetch("https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions", {

method: "POST",

headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}` },

body: JSON.stringify({

model: "sonar-pro",

messages: [

{ role: "system", content: "Brief, direct responses. No citations unless explicitly requested." },

{ role: "user", content: safeStr(message) },

],

}),

});



if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: `PPLX_HTTP_${r.status}` };



const j = await r.json();

let text = safeStr(j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "");

text = text.replace(/\[\d+\]/g, "").replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();

return { ok: true, text };

} catch (e) {

return { ok: false, error: `PPLX_FAIL:${safeStr(e?.message)}` };

}

}



/**

* PX POLICY (Move 64 Anchor)

* You must define POLICY_JSON (canonical triggers + peg + rounding).

* Until then, POLICY_HASH is a placeholder and PX endpoints still work, but audit will show placeholder.

*/

const POLICY_JSON = {

// TODO_PLACEHOLDER: define canonical triggers, peg, rounding, caps, anomaly thresholds

version: "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_V1",

peg_points_to_px: 0.0015, // TODO_PLACEHOLDER: confirm canonical peg

rounding: "floor", // TODO_PLACEHOLDER: choose: floor | ceil | bankers

daily_points_cap: 500, // TODO_PLACEHOLDER

weekly_points_cap: 2500, // TODO_PLACEHOLDER

earn_triggers: {

ATTENDANCE: 10,

DRILL_COMPLETE: 5,

PITCH_ATTEMPT: 15,

STREAK_DAY: 3,

// TODO_PLACEHOLDER: expand

},

};



const POLICY_HASH_PLACEHOLDER = "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_HASH_SHA256_HEX";



/**

* Router

*/

export default {

async fetch(req, env) {

const url = new URL(req.url);



if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {

return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders() });

}



try {

// PUBLIC: /health

if (url.pathname === "/health" && req.method === "GET") {

const res = { ok: true, status: "ASCENDED", version: VERSION, reality: REALITY, gospel: 444, ts: nowISO() };

const body = JSON.stringify(res);

enforceGospel444(body);

return new Response(body, { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// CHAT: /chat (x-chat-key required)

if (url.pathname === "/chat" && req.method === "POST") {

assert(ctEq(req.headers.get("x-chat-key"), env?.CHAT_KEY), "AUTH", "Invalid Chat Key", 401);



const body = await readJsonWithCap(req, LIMITS.maxBodyBytes);

const msg = safeStr(body?.message).trim();

assert(!!msg && msg.length <= LIMITS.chatMaxChars, "SCHEMA", "Invalid message length", 400);



// Local greeting gate (Wikipedia killer)

if (GREET_RE.test(msg)) {

const out = { ok: true, provider: "LOCAL", version: VERSION, response: "🦅 Phoenix Online. Awaiting instructions." };

const outStr = JSON.stringify(out);

enforceGospel444(outStr);

return new Response(outStr, { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



const enableSearch = wantsResearch(msg);

const result = await callPerplexity(env, msg);



if (!result.ok) {

const fallback = {

ok: true,

provider: "LOCAL_FALLBACK",

version: VERSION,

response: `Command received: "${msg}". (AI provider offline: ${result.error})`,

};

const s = JSON.stringify(fallback);

enforceGospel444(s);

return new Response(s, { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



const out = {

ok: true,

provider: enableSearch ? "PERPLEXITY(RESEARCH)" : "PERPLEXITY(CHAT)",

version: VERSION,

response: result.text,

};

const outStr = JSON.stringify(out);

enforceGospel444(outStr);

return new Response(outStr, { status: 200, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// ADMIN: /verifychain (x-sovereign-key required)

if (url.pathname === "/verifychain" && req.method === "GET") {

assert(ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env?.SOVEREIGN_KEY), "AUTH", "Sovereign required", 401);

const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");

return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch("https://do/verify");

}



// ADMIN: /ledger/append (x-sovereign-key required)

if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {

assert(ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env?.SOVEREIGN_KEY), "AUTH", "Sovereign required", 401);

const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");

return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(req);

}



// PX READ: /px/balance (x-chat-key required)

if (url.pathname === "/px/balance" && req.method === "POST") {

assert(ctEq(req.headers.get("x-chat-key"), env?.CHAT_KEY), "AUTH", "Invalid Chat Key", 401);

const body = await readJsonWithCap(req, LIMITS.maxBodyBytes);

const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();

assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);



const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");

return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch("https://do/px/balance", {

method: "POST",

headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },

body: JSON.stringify({ student_id }),

});

}



// PX ADMIN: /px/audit (x-sovereign-key required)

if (url.pathname === "/px/audit" && req.method === "GET") {

assert(ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env?.SOVEREIGN_KEY), "AUTH", "Sovereign required", 401);

const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");

return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch("https://do/px/audit");

}



// PX MUTATIONS: /px/earn, /px/redeem (x-sovereign-key required)

if ((url.pathname === "/px/earn" || url.pathname === "/px/redeem") && req.method === "POST") {

assert(ctEq(req.headers.get("x-sovereign-key"), env?.SOVEREIGN_KEY), "AUTH", "Sovereign required", 401);

const id = env.LEDGER.idFromName("GLOBAL");

return env.LEDGER.get(id).fetch(req);

}



return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "NOT_FOUND" }), {

status: 404,

headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" },

});

} catch (e) {

const status = e?.phx?.status || 500;

const payload = { ok: false, error: e?.phx?.code || "INTERNAL_HALT", detail: e?.phx?.detail || safeStr(e?.message) };

const s = JSON.stringify(payload);

// Gospel check here is optional; if it halts, we still want to return something. So we do not enforce here.

return new Response(s, { status, headers: { ...corsHeaders(), "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}

},

};



/**

* DURABLE OBJECT: PhoenixLedgerDOv2 (KV / state.storage)

* - Ledger: /verify, /ledger/append

* - PX Sub-ledger: /px/earn, /px/redeem, /px/balance, /px/audit

* - Alarm: GC idempotency keys (24h TTL)

*/

export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 {

constructor(state, env) {

this.state = state;

this.env = env;

}



async _getLedgerHead() {

const height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) ?? 0;

const head_hash = (await this.state.storage.get(`block:${height}:hash`)) ?? "GENESIS";

return { height, head_hash };

}



async _ensureGenesis() {

const has = await this.state.storage.get("genesis_done");

if (has) return;

const genesisHash = await sha256Hex("GENESIS");

await this.state.storage.put({

genesis_done: true,

height: 0,

"block:0": { height: 0, hash: genesisHash, prev_hash: "GENESIS", kind: "GENESIS", payload: { kind: "GENESIS" }, ts: nowISO() },

"block:0:hash": genesisHash,

});

}



// PX helpers

_pxBalKey(studentId) {

return `px:bal:${studentId}`;

}

_pxIdemKey(idem) {

return `px:idem:${idem}`;

}

_pxIdemExpKey(idem) {

return `px:idemexp:${idem}`;

}

_pxBlockKey(h) {

return `px:block:${h}`;

}



async _pxConvertPointsToPx(points) {

const peg = Number(POLICY_JSON?.peg_points_to_px || 0);

const rounding = safeStr(POLICY_JSON?.rounding || "floor");

const raw = Number(points) * peg;



if (!Number.isFinite(raw) || raw <= 0) HALT("PX_CONVERT", "Invalid conversion result");

if (rounding === "ceil") return Math.ceil(raw * 1e6) / 1e6;

if (rounding === "bankers") {

// TODO_PLACEHOLDER: bankers rounding implementation; using floor fallback for now

return Math.floor(raw * 1e6) / 1e6;

}

return Math.floor(raw * 1e6) / 1e6; // floor default

}



async _appendPxEvent(event, idemKey, ttlMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {

const idem = safeStr(idemKey).trim();

assert(!!idem, "SCHEMA", "idempotency_key required", 400);



// Fast idempotency check

const existing = await this.state.storage.get(this._pxIdemKey(idem));

if (existing) return existing;



// Fail-closed serialize + atomic commit

return await this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {

// Re-check inside lock

const again = await this.state.storage.get(this._pxIdemKey(idem));

if (again) return again;



const student_id = safeStr(event?.student_id).trim();

assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);



const type = safeStr(event?.type).toUpperCase();

assert(type === "EARN" || type === "REDEEM" || type === "MINT" || type === "BURN", "SCHEMA", "invalid event type", 400);



const amount_px = Number(event?.amount_px);

assert(Number.isFinite(amount_px) && amount_px > 0, "SCHEMA", "amount_px must be > 0", 400);



// Balance invariant

const balKey = this._pxBalKey(student_id);

let balance = Number((await this.state.storage.get(balKey)) ?? 0);

if (!Number.isFinite(balance) || balance < 0) balance = 0;



if ((type === "REDEEM" || type === "BURN") && balance < amount_px) {

HALT("INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS", `Underflow for ${student_id}`, 423);

}



const nextBalance = (type === "REDEEM" || type === "BURN") ? balance - amount_px : balance + amount_px;



// Height

const height = Number((await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0);

const nextHeight = height + 1;



const sealed = {

...event,

type,

student_id,

amount_px,

policy_hash: POLICY_HASH_PLACEHOLDER, // TODO_PLACEHOLDER: compute sha256(POLICY_JSON canonical)

ts: nowISO(),

px_height: nextHeight,

};



const result = { ok: true, px_height: nextHeight, student_id, balance: nextBalance, event: sealed };



// Commit

await this.state.storage.put({

[balKey]: nextBalance,

[this._pxBlockKey(nextHeight)]: sealed,

[this._pxIdemKey(idem)]: result,

[this._pxIdemExpKey(idem)]: Date.now() + ttlMs,

"px:height": nextHeight,

});



// Ensure alarm for GC

await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + ttlMs);



return result;

});

}



async alarm() {

// GC expired idempotency keys (best-effort; fail-closed not required here)

try {

const now = Date.now();

const list = await this.state.storage.list({ prefix: "px:idemexp:" });

const deletions = [];

for (const [k, exp] of list.entries()) {

const expMs = Number(exp);

if (Number.isFinite(expMs) && expMs <= now) {

const idem = k.replace("px:idemexp:", "");

deletions.push(k);

deletions.push(this._pxIdemKey(idem));

}

}

if (deletions.length) await this.state.storage.delete(deletions);



// If there are still future expiries, set alarm to the soonest one

let soonest = Infinity;

for (const exp of list.values()) {

const expMs = Number(exp);

if (Number.isFinite(expMs) && expMs > now && expMs < soonest) soonest = expMs;

}

if (soonest !== Infinity) await this.state.storage.setAlarm(soonest);

} catch {

// ignore

}

}



async fetch(req) {

await this._ensureGenesis();

const url = new URL(req.url);



// Ledger verify (called by /verifychain router)

if (url.pathname === "/verify") {

const head = await this._getLedgerHead();

return new Response(JSON.stringify({

ok: true,

height: head.height,

head_hash: head.head_hash,

stone_sky: true,

ts: nowISO(),

}), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// Ledger append (called by /ledger/append router)

if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {

return await this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {

const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

const payload = body?.payload ?? body;

const kind = safeStr(body?.kind || "EVENT");



const head = await this._getLedgerHead();

const nextHeight = head.height + 1;

const payloadStr = JSON.stringify({ kind, payload });

const hash = await sha256Hex(`H:${nextHeight}:${head.head_hash}:${payloadStr}`);



const block = { height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: head.head_hash, kind, payload, ts: nowISO() };



await this.state.storage.put({

[`block:${nextHeight}`]: block,

[`block:${nextHeight}:hash`]: hash,

height: nextHeight,

});



return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, height: nextHeight, hash, prev_hash: head.head_hash }), {

status: 200,

headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },

});

});

}



// PX balance (read-only; router enforces chat-key)

if (url.pathname === "/px/balance" && req.method === "POST") {

const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();

assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);



const bal = Number((await this.state.storage.get(this._pxBalKey(student_id))) ?? 0);

const px_height = Number((await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0);



const out = { ok: true, student_id, balance: Number.isFinite(bal) ? bal : 0, px_height, policy_hash: POLICY_HASH_PLACEHOLDER };

return new Response(JSON.stringify(out), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// PX audit (admin; router enforces sovereign-key)

if (url.pathname === "/px/audit" && req.method === "GET") {

const px_height = Number((await this.state.storage.get("px:height")) ?? 0);

// total_supply is not stored directly here; we can approximate as sum(balances) if we iterate.

// NOTE: storage.list over all balances may be expensive if huge; OK for early stage.

const balances = await this.state.storage.list({ prefix: "px:bal:" });

let total_supply = 0;

for (const v of balances.values()) {

const n = Number(v);

if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) total_supply += n;

}

const out = {

ok: true,

px_height,

total_supply,

policy_hash: POLICY_HASH_PLACEHOLDER,

policy_version: POLICY_JSON?.version || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_POLICY_V1",

ts: nowISO(),

};

return new Response(JSON.stringify(out), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// PX earn (admin; router enforces sovereign-key)

if (url.pathname === "/px/earn" && req.method === "POST") {

const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();

const points = Number(body?.points);

const trigger = safeStr(body?.trigger || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_TRIGGER").trim();

const idempotency_key = safeStr(body?.idempotency_key || body?.idem).trim();

const proof_ref = safeStr(body?.proof_ref || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_PROOF_REF").trim();

const anomaly_score = body?.anomaly_score === undefined ? 0 : Number(body?.anomaly_score);



assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);

assert(Number.isInteger(points) && points >= 1, "SCHEMA", "points must be integer >= 1", 400);

assert(!!idempotency_key, "SCHEMA", "idempotency_key required", 400);

assert(!!proof_ref, "SCHEMA", "proof_ref required", 400);



// Caps (fail-closed if missing)

const dailyCap = Number(POLICY_JSON?.daily_points_cap);

const weeklyCap = Number(POLICY_JSON?.weekly_points_cap);

assert(Number.isFinite(dailyCap) && dailyCap > 0, "POLICY", "daily_points_cap invalid", 423);

assert(Number.isFinite(weeklyCap) && weeklyCap > 0, "POLICY", "weekly_points_cap invalid", 423);



// TODO_PLACEHOLDER: implement per-day/per-week counters keyed by date/week.

// For now: accept points but flag anomaly if anomaly_score high.

if (Number.isFinite(anomaly_score) && anomaly_score >= 0.95) {

// fail-closed path for extreme anomaly

HALT("ANOMALY", "Anomaly score too high", 423);

}



const amount_px = await this._pxConvertPointsToPx(points);



const event = {

type: "EARN",

student_id,

points,

amount_px,

trigger,

idempotency_key,

proof_ref,

anomaly_score: Number.isFinite(anomaly_score) ? anomaly_score : 0,

};



const result = await this._appendPxEvent(event, idempotency_key);

return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// PX redeem (admin; router enforces sovereign-key)

if (url.pathname === "/px/redeem" && req.method === "POST") {

const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

const student_id = safeStr(body?.student_id).trim();

const amount_px = Number(body?.amount_px);

const sku = safeStr(body?.sku || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_SKU").trim();

const idempotency_key = safeStr(body?.idempotency_key || body?.idem).trim();

const inventory_ref = safeStr(body?.inventory_ref || "TODO_PLACEHOLDER_INVENTORY_REF").trim();



assert(!!student_id, "SCHEMA", "student_id required", 400);

assert(Number.isFinite(amount_px) && amount_px > 0, "SCHEMA", "amount_px must be > 0", 400);

assert(!!sku, "SCHEMA", "sku required", 400);

assert(!!idempotency_key, "SCHEMA", "idempotency_key required", 400);

assert(!!inventory_ref, "SCHEMA", "inventory_ref required", 400);



// TODO_PLACEHOLDER: implement real inventory/capacity checks

// For now: accept inventory_ref existence as “proof”

const event = {

type: "REDEEM",

student_id,

amount_px,

sku,

idempotency_key,

inventory_ref,

};



const result = await this._appendPxEvent(event, idempotency_key);

return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });

}

}

async function sha256(str) {

const buf = new TextEncoder().encode(str);

const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);

return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');

}

try {

}), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...CORS } });

return await env.LEDGER.get(env.LEDGER.idFromName("OMEGA_PRIME")).fetch(request);

}



return new Response("PHOENIX GATE: 404", { status: 404, headers: CORS });



} catch (e) {

return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: e.message }), { status: 500, headers: CORS });

}

}

};

async function sha256Hex(str) {

const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(str));

return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

}

// 3. THE AUTHORITY (Active PhoenixLedgerDOv2)

export class PhoenixLedgerDOv2 extends DurableObject {

constructor(state, env) {

super(state, env);

this.state = state;

this.env = env;

}



async fetch(request) {

const url = new URL(request.url);



// VERIFY CHAIN (Read)

if (url.pathname === "/verifychain") {

let height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;

let head_hash = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";

return new Response(JSON.stringify({

ok: true,

stone_sky: true,

height: height,

head_hash: head_hash

}), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}



// APPEND (Write)

if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" || request.method === "POST") {

const data = await request.json();

let height = (await this.state.storage.get("height")) || 0;

let prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get("latest_hash")) || "GENESIS";



const newHeight = height + 1;

const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();



// CHECKPOINT LOGIC

const cadence = parseInt(this.env.CHECKPOINT_CADENCE || "100");

if (newHeight % cadence === 0) {

data.checkpoint_hash = this.env.POLICY_HASH || "UNVERIFIED";

data.type = "CHECKPOINT";

}



// HASHING

const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(data);

const newHash = await sha256Hex(`${newHeight}:${prevHash}:${timestamp}:${payloadStr}`);



await this.state.storage.put("height", newHeight);

await this.state.storage.put("latest_hash", newHash);

await this.state.storage.put(`block_${newHeight}`, { ts: timestamp, hash: newHash, data });



return new Response(JSON.stringify({

status: "COMMITTED",

height: newHeight,

hash: newHash

}), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

}

return new Response("DO OK");

}

}
